Researcher Danny Goler ran an informal experiment in which volunteers used DMT under observation and reported their experiences. He joins Danny Jones to discuss its strangest result. Many subjects described the same symbols. Goler presents them as an alien code hidden in the fabric of reality.

The experiment leaned on laser light and repeated sessions, and Goler describes the shared imagery his subjects reported seeing. Jones presses him on suggestion, expectation, and what would falsify the code idea. The work sits far outside controlled science, and Goler's reading of it is his own. The episode preserves a claim currently spreading through psychedelic culture at the moment of its making, in its maker's voice. Listeners can judge whether the pattern sounds like discovery or like the oldest trap in the study of visions.
